messages:
olivia: quick sync — proposing a rollforward plan for audit event schema to add correlation_id, request_path, client_sdk and to deprecate legacy_actor and session_token. need migration and customer validation strategy.
raj: +1. do we treat this as a major breaking change (major bump) or a compatible additive with deprecations? also: how do we record schema provenance?
maria: from CS perspective customers want a validator + sample payloads. also ask about signed events (KMS) — will the signature cover the new fields or do we version signatures?
sec-bot: test-suite: audit-schema-compat checks started on staging. 14 tests passing so far. :construction:
sam: note: RBAC change — we need to restrict who can emit admin_action events when actor shape changes. propose 2-phase: (1) accept new fields but keep legacy fields honored, (2) remove legacy fields after N weeks behind a gating flag.
jordan: Dedicated/Private customers: they often pin collectors and validators. we should provide a compatibility header and a runtime feature flag so customers can opt-in before we remove fields. also document KMS key id field name so HSM integrations map cleanly.
olivia: proposed policy: embed a flat "schema_version" string in every event and publish a migration playbook. example naming: "schema_version": "audit.v3.2025-03". We avoid semver because consumers treat changes as contract signals.
raj: agree on schema_version. also add a lightweight `deprecated_fields` array in the event metadata so consumers can surface warnings. we can emit a deprecation warning event to customers when they consume deprecated fields.
maria: i'll own customer validator endpoints + sample payload repo. plan: (a) public validator endpoint that returns warnings/errors, (b) opt-in strict mode for customers to enforce the new schema, (c) webhook for validation alerts. ETA: two weeks for MVP.
sam: action items: 1) add schema_version to payload (owner: olivia) 2) add deprecated_fields metadata + warning events (owner: raj) 3) validator + opt-in strict mode (owner: maria) 4) RBAC rule update for admin_action (owner: sam) 5) Dedicated/private compatibility flag in serving runtime (owner: jordan). target: staging roll in 14 days, production cut in 30 days.
olivia: example before/after (staging test payload):
```json
{
  "evt_id": "evt_01",
  "schema_version": "audit.v2.2024-10",
  "actor": {"id":"u-123","type":"user"},
  "legacy_actor": "user:u-123",
  "action": "create_model"
}

After:
{
  "evt_id": "evt_01",
  "schema_version": "audit.v3.2025-03",
  "correlation_id": "corr-9f1a",
  "request_path": "/api/v1/models",
  "client_sdk": "js@1.4.2",
  "actor": {"id":"u-123","type":"user"},
  "deprecated_fields": ["legacy_actor","session_token"]
}
```
raj: we should also add a small rollout hook in the Console that lets customers preview events with the new schema (toggle = preview_schema_v3). ops: make sure logs still index under old keys for 30 days for backfills.
maria: customer comms plan: initial notice, 2-week preview, enforced removal 30 days after preview end. i'll draft an RFC and a short FAQ.
jordan: for Private installs, we'll publish a migration bundle and a compatibility patch so they can run both schemas during their maintenance window.
olivia: ok team — agreed on owners and rough timeline. i'll schedule a short sync (Tuesday 10am) to confirm cutover window and rollback steps. please drop any missing risks here. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: commit: "audit: add schema_version field + validator scaffold" pushed to infra/audit-schema branch by olivia at 2025-03-08T16:12:03Z
